title: Problem
问题
html:
Most multimodal reward models are vision-centric, scalar-only, and dependent on expensive human preferences. The paper asks how to build a rubric-grounded reward model spanning text, image, video, and audio.

Omni-RRM releases Omni-Preference, containing response pairs, modality-aware rubrics, dimension-wise reasons, and preference judgments across text, image, video, and audio. Training uses SFT followed by GRPO on difficult low-contrast pairs.

现有多模态RM多以视觉为中心、输出不透明标量并依赖昂贵人工偏好，难覆盖文本、图像、视频和音频。

Omni-RRM发布自动合成的Omni-Preference：候选对、模态感知rubric、逐维理由和偏好结论；模型先SFT再用GRPO强化困难低差异样本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Omni-RRM releases Omni-Preference, containing response pairs, modality-aware rubrics, dimension-wise reasons, and preference judgments across text, image, video, and audio. Training uses SFT followed by GRPO on difficult low-contrast pairs.

Models with different capabilities generate candidates. Strong teachers reconcile conflicts, filter pairs, and write modality-aware rubric rationales.

Omni-RRM发布自动合成的Omni-Preference：候选对、模态感知rubric、逐维理由和偏好结论；模型先SFT再用GRPO强化困难低差异样本。

不同能力模型生成候选回应，强teacher协调冲突、过滤并产生modality-awarerubricrationale；通过SFT学习结构，再以可验证偏好奖励进行GRPO。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Synthesize cross-modal response pairs. Models with different capabilities generate candidates.
  2. Generate modality-aware rubrics and rationales. Strong teachers reconcile conflicts, filter pairs, and write modality-aware rubric rationales.
  3. Reconcile and filter teacher judgments. SFT teaches the structured output, and GRPO sharpens difficult discrimination.
  4. Train with SFT and difficult-pair GRPO. SFT teaches the structured output, and GRPO sharpens difficult discrimination.

1. 合成跨模态候选回应对。 不同能力模型生成候选回应，强teacher协调冲突、过滤并产生modality-awarerubricrationale；
  2. 生成模态感知 rubric 与理由。 通过SFT学习结构，再以可验证偏好奖励进行GRPO。
  3. 协调并过滤 teacher 判断。 通过SFT学习结构，再以可验证偏好奖励进行GRPO。
  4. 使用 SFT 与困难偏好对 GRPO 训练。 通过SFT学习结构，再以可验证偏好奖励进行GRPO。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Omni-RRM reaches 80.2% on ShareGPT-V and 66.8% on Audio-HH-RLHF, with a 17.7-point overall gain over its base model on image tasks. It also improves Best-of-N selection and transfers to text benchmarks.

The entire corpus inherits teacher-model bias, and an anonymous repository limits long-term provenance. Shared formatting does not guarantee calibration across modalities.

在ShareGPT-V达到80.2%，Audio-HH-RLHF达到66.8%，图像总体相对base提升17.7%，并能用于Best-of-N和文本迁移。

完全自动合成会继承teacher偏差，匿名归档限制长期可审计性；模态间标准不同，统一格式不等于统一校准。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Unlike vision-centric scalar rewards, Omni-RRM provides rubric-grounded, dimension-specific judgments across four modalities through a fully automated synthesis pipeline.

Most multimodal reward models are vision-centric, scalar-only, and dependent on expensive human preferences. The paper asks how to build a rubric-grounded reward model spanning text, image, video, and audio.

新意是跨四模态、逐维rubric-grounded的自动偏好合成，而非视觉标量RM；同时明确理由与难例RL。

现有多模态RM多以视觉为中心、输出不透明标量并依赖昂贵人工偏好，难覆盖文本、图像、视频和音频。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Primary limitation. The entire corpus inherits teacher-model bias, and an anonymous repository limits long-term provenance. Human agreement and per-modality calibration should be measured before deployment.
  2. Curator audit risk. Shared formatting does not guarantee calibration across modalities. Replication should separate dataset artifacts from the claimed mechanism and report failures by task or subgroup.

1. 主要局限。完全自动合成会继承teacher偏差，匿名归档限制长期可审计性；复用应按模态进行人工一致性和校准检查。
  2. 策展审计风险。模态间标准不同，统一格式不等于统一校准。复现时应把数据 artifact 带来的收益与方法机制分开，并按任务或群体报告失败情况。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Training or data construction. Omni-Preference can train omni-modal judges and support Best-of-N or data auditing. Success should be checked with the paper’s main held-out metric under a fixed base model and data budget.
  2. Evaluation or auditing. Human agreement and per-modality calibration should be measured before deployment. Do not use the method unchanged when its verifier, rubric, modality, or annotation assumptions do not hold.

1. 训练或数据构造。可训练omnijudge、Best-of-N选择和多模态数据审计；复用时应固定基础模型与数据预算，并使用论文主要留出指标检查是否真正有效。
  2. 评测或审计。复用应按模态进行人工一致性和校准检查。当任务不满足原论文的 verifier、rubric、模态或标注假设时，不能未经修改直接使用。
